info.title: Vixeo
info.description: API de Vixeo : comptes, profils, synchronisation et configuration distante.

get.description:
Called by the app at launch and when it comes back to the foreground, before any sign-in.
`update_required`: the app blocks until the update is installed; `update_available`: it
suggests it once.

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: Platform of the installed app (`android` also covers Android TV).

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Version name of the installed app ("1.2.0"). Optional: older builds don't send it.

parameters.name: build
parameters.description: Build number of the installed app (`CFBundleVersion` on iOS, `versionCode` on Android).

current_version.description: Version name sent by the app (null for older builds that don't send it).

latest.description: Newest Android release published on GitHub, or null if none yet (always null on iOS).

notes.description: What's new, in French (may be null).

download_url.description: Android: the APK to download and install (https), or null.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the APK, to check before installing (null without APK).

minimum_build.description: Installs older than this build must update: a GitHub release marked « [obligatoire] » (null: none).

update_url.description: Page where the update is installed: the site's install page (no Play Store).

E-mails a 6-digit code, valid 15 minutes, if an account uses this address. The answer is the
same whether or not the address has an account.

Signs out every device of the account, then returns a token for this one, like `login`.

Items carry their title logo (`logo_url`) and a textless poster, unlike other lists.

Movies and TV shows by id (Ma liste, Continuer à regarder), with their logo, length, genres
and age rating, in the order asked: one request instead of one per title. Respects the
active profile's age limit; titles TMDb doesn't know are left out.

First page of movies, TV shows and people, grouped. Use the per-type search for more.
Movies and TV shows respect the active profile's age limit.

With a filter (genre, years, rating) or another order than relevance, movies and TV shows
are the matching titles among the first 60 results of each, sorted; people are only
returned without a filter.

post.description:
Deletes the account, its profiles, their list, progress and history, and signs out every
device. Cannot be undone. The password is sent in the body (POST, not DELETE: never a
secret in a URL).

Sends a JSON file with the account, profiles, list, progress and devices to the account's
address (GDPR right of access and portability). Limited to 3 per hour.
post.summary: E-mail a copy of the account's data

get.description: One entry per API token, most recently used first.

delete.description:
Revokes one of the account's tokens (a TV, a phone…). To sign out the current device, use
`auth/logout`.

get.description: `linked: false` (other fields null) when the profile has none.

delete.description: The ratings stay on TMDb; Vixeo's session on the account is ended.

post.description:
Open `authorize_url` (or show it as a QR code on a TV): the person signs in to TMDb and
approves Vixeo, then the app polls POST …/tmdb/link/complete every `interval` seconds.
Linking again replaces the current account.

authorize_url.description: TMDb page where the person approves Vixeo.

post.description:
202 `{"status":"pending"}` until the person approved Vixeo on TMDb, then 200 with the
account. 410 when the approval page expired: start again.

message.const: La page d’autorisation TMDb a expiré : recommencez.

get.description:
Every type, or one, with the comments: the most recently rated first, or sorted by `sort`
(oldest, highest, lowest rating; equal ratings: the most recent first). Filtered by the
profile's age limit. Ratings given on themoviedb.org show up within 10 minutes.

parameters.name: sort

recent (default), oldest, highest (best rated first) or lowest (worst rated first). | | |---| | `recent`

Worst rated first (then the most recent). |

An account can have at most 5 profiles. Requires `parental_pin` when parental control is on.
Without `avatar`, the profile gets one of the catalog at random.

Runs the scraper's extractor for the link's host and returns the HLS/MP4 stream the

get.description:
The player loads this URL without a bearer token: the signed, opaque token in the path is
what authorises it. An HLS playlist is rewritten so its URIs point back to this server.
get.summary: Media of a channel, proxied (HLS playlist and its segments)

get.description:
The image (PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF), served from our origin: the `logo` URL of a channel.
404 when the provider has no usable image (the app then shows its own icon).
The categories the channels are sorted into (Sport, Cinéma, Info…).
Optionally filtered by category_id, and by a name search with q.

Its name, category and logo (an image on our origin, `GET /tv/logo/{hash}`; null when the
provider has none): the channel page of the app.

The provider internals stay server-side. The app receives a playlist URL on our own origin
(so it works over HTTPS even when the provider only serves plain HTTP) and no headers: the
player loads the media itself, through the token in the URL.
get.summary: Resolve a playable stream for a channel
